pages.title: Archie Axolotl Squishmallow with an Oval Belly Coloring Page
pages.description: Archie faces forward in this printable coloring page, showing three rounded gills on each side, short flippers, a catlike smile, and a broad oval belly. The egg-shaped Squishmallow body creates large open areas, with bold contours separating the belly panel from the surrounding outline.

pages.title: Archie Axolotl Wearing a Bunny Hoodie Coloring Page
pages.description: Archie wears a bunny hoodie in this printable coloring page, with tall rabbit ears, a nose above the hood opening, and a bow beneath his face. His axolotl gills extend from both sides, while the hood, ribbon loops, and divided belly provide separate enclosed shapes to color.

pages.title: Archie Axolotl Wearing a Cat Costume Coloring Page
pages.description: Archie wears a cat costume in this printable coloring page, with pointed hood ears, whisker marks, and a round bell above his oval belly panel. Six axolotl gills frame the face, and his short flippers rest beside the wide, unfilled body of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Archie Axolotl Dressed as a Snowman Coloring Page
pages.description: Archie becomes a snowman in this printable coloring page, wearing a tall holly-trimmed hat and a scarf above three buttons, with a carrot-shaped nose. His axolotl gills remain visible beside the head, while the scarf ends, holly leaves, and round buttons add smaller coloring sections.

pages.title: Archie Axolotl in a Pool Float with Sunglasses Coloring Page
pages.description: Archie sits inside a pool float in this printable coloring page, wearing large sunglasses while his short flippers rest over the inflatable ring's curved rim. A few ripples surround the float, and broad curved panels divide the ring into distinct open areas beneath the axolotl's gills.

pages.title: Archie Axolotl Playing Soccer in a Jersey Coloring Page
pages.description: Archie kicks a soccer ball in this printable coloring page, wearing a jersey with an outlined number one, striped sleeves, and a broad lower band. Two short feet support the action, and grass tufts sit below the bold axolotl silhouette without crowding the ball's enclosed panels.

pages.title: Archie Axolotl Holding a Heart Ice Cream Scoop Coloring Page
pages.description: Archie holds an ice cream cone in this printable coloring page, with a large heart-shaped scoop above a dripping edge and a crosshatched waffle cone. Both flippers touch the cone, leaving the face and six gills clear above the broad belly areas of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Archie Axolotl Holding a Balloon with a Sprinkle Belly Coloring Page
pages.description: Archie holds a balloon in this printable coloring page, with one flipper around the curved string and outlined sprinkles scattered across his oval belly panel. The balloon rises above his gills, creating a tall composition with large open spaces inside the body, balloon, and rounded sprinkles.

pages.title: Archie Axolotl with Star Sunglasses and Music Notes Coloring Page
pages.description: Archie wears star-shaped sunglasses in this printable coloring page, with outlined musical notes and stars spread across his belly beneath a small open smile. His short flippers and six gills create a clear outer silhouette, while the decorative shapes form separate white areas on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Christmas Archie Axolotl with Snowflake Patterns Coloring Page
pages.description: Christmas Archie wears a Santa hat in this printable coloring page, with outlined snowflakes across his body, a fluffy hat brim, and a hanging loop. The oval belly stays open beneath the snowflake motifs, and all six axolotl gills remain visible beside the rounded holiday hat.

pages.title: Archie Axolotl HugMees with Two Belly Hearts Coloring Page
pages.description: Archie appears in his HugMees shape in this printable coloring page, with two hearts on an elongated belly, outstretched flippers, and two short rounded feet. Three gills extend from each side of his head, and the large heart outlines leave generous open spaces within the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Archie and Clutch Squishmallows Playing Soccer Coloring Page
pages.description: Archie and Clutch share a soccer ball in this printable coloring page, with both axolotls facing forward and Clutch's sprinkle-patterned belly distinguishing the pair. Their separate flippers and gills remain readable around the ball, while a few grass tufts mark the ground below the rounded bodies.

pages.title: Archie, Monica and Anastasia Squishmallows Coloring Page
pages.description: Archie, Monica, and Anastasia form a three-axolotl group in this printable coloring page, with rounded bodies, oval belly panels, and one flower beside a gill. One character sits behind the other two, creating clear overlapping silhouettes with large open areas across the bodies and small flower details.

pages.title: Monica Axolotl Wearing a Flower Headband Coloring Page
pages.description: Monica wears a flower headband in this printable coloring page, with three large blossoms above her face, curved eyelashes, and an open oval belly panel. Six gills extend beyond the headband, while short flippers frame the body and the broad petals provide additional shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Monica Axolotl in a Winged Bat Costume Coloring Page
pages.description: Monica wears a bat costume in this printable coloring page, with pointed hood ears, scalloped wings, and a small bow tied below her smiling face. Her axolotl gills remain visible between the hood and wings, and the open belly, wing panels, and ribbon loops offer different enclosed areas.

pages.title: Monica Axolotl Holding a Wrapped Present Coloring Page
pages.description: Monica holds a wrapped present in this printable coloring page, with a large ribbon bow, a vertical gift ribbon, and short flippers around the box. Her rounded face and six gills stay visible above the gift, while the box and belly form broad, clearly separated spaces to color.

pages.title: Monica Axolotl with a Graduation Cap and Diploma Coloring Page
pages.description: Monica wears a graduation cap in this printable coloring page, holding a rolled diploma tied with a bow beneath the cap's long tassel and square top. Her gills frame the face, and the simple oval belly contrasts with the smaller ribbon loops and layered edges of the diploma.

pages.title: Monica Axolotl Holding a Pretzel with Hearts Coloring Page
pages.description: Monica holds a pretzel in this printable coloring page, with overlapping dough loops, small heart decorations, and two rounded flippers supporting the sides beneath her smile. The pretzel's open centers remain distinct from her belly, creating a mix of broad body areas and smaller enclosed shapes on the sheet.

pages.title: Monica Squish-Doo with a Fluffy Ponytail Coloring Page
pages.description: Monica shows her Squish-Doo hairstyle in this printable coloring page, with a tall fluffy ponytail, a wide hairband, and curved bangs above her smiling face. Six gills sit beside the head, while the large oval belly and short flippers keep the lower portion of the coloring sheet open.

pages.title: Monica Axolotl Playing a Drum Set Coloring Page
pages.description: Monica plays drums in this printable coloring page, holding two drumsticks above a large bass drum, two smaller drums, and a cymbal on a stand. Her face and gills stay visible above the instruments, with clear gaps between the drum supports, cymbal legs, and rounded body.

pages.title: Gabin the Pumpkin Axolotl Squishmallow Coloring Page
pages.description: Gabin combines a pumpkin body with axolotl gills in this printable coloring page, showing a curved stem, vertical pumpkin ribs, and two short side flippers. A broad oval belly interrupts the curved ribs, leaving large white panels beneath the smiling face and the leafy shape around the stem.

pages.title: Aika Axolotl Holding a Carton of French Fries Coloring Page
pages.description: Aika holds a carton of French fries in this printable coloring page, with thick outlined fries above the curved carton rim and flippers touching both sides. Her six gills and smiling face remain clear, while the plain carton, oval belly, and rounded body provide broad open areas on the sheet.

pages.title: Aika Axolotl Holding a Cup of Lemonade Coloring Page
pages.description: Aika holds lemonade in this printable coloring page, with a lemon slice on the cup's rim, a long straw, and three outlined ice cubes inside. Both flippers support the cup, and the drink's curved edges create smaller sections against the wide belly and simple axolotl body.

pages.title: Aika Axolotl Running Beside the Waves Coloring Page
pages.description: Aika runs along the beach in this printable coloring page, with short raised flippers, rounded feet, a visible tail, and shells beside the curving shoreline. A few wave lines establish the setting, while the large belly and six gills keep the axolotl prominent within the open composition.

pages.title: Tinley Axolotl Wearing a Bunny Ear Headband Coloring Page
pages.description: Tinley wears a bunny ear headband in this printable coloring page, with two tall ears above her face, six side gills, and two short flippers. Inner ear panels, the headband strip, and a broad oval belly create simple enclosed areas within the rounded silhouette of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Tinley Axolotl Ice Cream Cone with a Cherry Coloring Page
pages.description: Tinley becomes an axolotl ice cream cone in this printable coloring page, with a cherry on top, heart sprinkles, dripping topping, and a waffle-patterned lower body. Six gills and two short flippers preserve the character's shape, while the cone's crossing lines create smaller spaces below the open face.

pages.title: Tinley Axolotl Holding a Flower Bouquet Coloring Page
pages.description: Tinley holds a flower bouquet in this printable coloring page, with three large blossoms, pointed leaves, visible stems, and a ribbon bow between her flippers. The bouquet sits below her smiling face and six gills, adding smaller petal and ribbon shapes to the wide belly area.

pages.title: Tinley Axolotl Cooking Pasta in a Chef Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: Tinley cooks pasta in this printable coloring page, wearing a chef hat while stirring a handled pot beside a plate of noodles topped with leaves. A small stove supports the pot, and the continuous spoon, curved noodles, broad hat panels, and axolotl body provide varied enclosed coloring areas.

pages.title: Treyton Axolotl with Lemon Meringue Pie Coloring Page
pages.description: Treyton holds lemon meringue pie in this printable coloring page, with a raised topping, a lemon slice, and a layered crust resting on an oval plate. His two flippers support the plate below his smile, while six gills and a broad belly frame the smaller dessert details.

pages.title: Treyton Axolotl Wearing a Bandana and Flower Coloring Page
pages.description: Treyton wears a bandana in this printable coloring page, with a large flower beside one gill, a triangular neck panel, and short flippers at his sides. The flower's rounded petals contrast with the pointed bandana, while the plain oval belly leaves a broad open area on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mipsy Axolotl Holding a Candy Apple Coloring Page
pages.description: Mipsy holds a candy apple in this printable coloring page, with a dripping coating across the round fruit and both short flippers around the long stick. Her oval belly, smiling face, and six side gills remain clearly outlined, leaving large open spaces around the smaller apple and coating shapes.

pages.title: Mipsy Axolotl Organizing Storage Boxes Coloring Page
pages.description: Mipsy organizes storage boxes in this printable coloring page, reaching toward a shelf with heart and star labels while a flower-labeled box sits in front. The boxes have clear lids and corners, and her short flippers, six gills, and broad belly remain distinct from the simple shelving.

pages.title: Avana Spotted Axolotl Wearing a Crown Coloring Page
pages.description: Avana wears a crown in this printable coloring page, with outlined spots across the body, three round crown tips, and a diamond-shaped decoration above the face. Her six gills and short flippers surround a broad oval belly, while the crown and scattered spots add smaller enclosed shapes to color.

pages.title: Noelani Axolotl with Wings and a Fuzzy Belly Coloring Page
pages.description: Noelani displays small wings in this printable coloring page, with three axolotl gills on each side, two short flippers, and a large scalloped belly panel. The wings sit behind the body without covering the face, and their featherlike lobes contrast with the soft rounded contour of the belly.

pages.title: Prometheus the S'more Axolotl Squishmallow Coloring Page
pages.description: Prometheus appears as a s'more axolotl in this printable coloring page, with a marshmallow-shaped body between cracker layers, a wavy filling edge, and six side gills. Short flippers sit above the lower cracker, while small oval cracker marks and broad filling bands provide contrasting shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Nattie Axolotl in a Hershey's Kiss Costume Coloring Page
pages.description: Nattie wears a Hershey's Kiss costume in this printable coloring page, with a pointed wrapper hood, a blank paper plume, and curved folds below her face. Six axolotl gills and two short flippers emerge from the costume, while the large wrapper panels remain open between the simple fold lines.

pages.title: Svenja Axolotl Holding a Christmas Wreath Coloring Page
pages.description: Svenja holds a Christmas wreath in this printable coloring page, with large overlapping leaves, a ribbon bow, and an open circular center below her smiling face. Her flippers touch both sides of the wreath, while the leaf outlines and bow loops form smaller sections against the broad axolotl body.

pages.title: Cressida Axolotl with Moons and Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: Cressida shows moon and star patterns in this printable coloring page, with crescent shapes across her body, six rounded gills, and curved bands inside her belly. Two short flippers frame the patterned torso, combining large open stripes with smaller stars and crescents in the same clear coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cressida Axolotl Coding on a Laptop Coloring Page
pages.description: Cressida works at a laptop in this printable coloring page, with moon and star markings, a striped belly, and short flippers resting over the keyboard. Outlined code symbols decorate the laptop lid, and the desk's simple legs leave open space below the prominent axolotl face and gills.

pages.title: Anastasia Axolotl Holding a Project Checklist Coloring Page
pages.description: Anastasia holds a project checklist in this printable coloring page, with four empty checkboxes, horizontal writing lines, and a pencil supported by her other flipper. The clipboard's rounded corners and top clip remain separate from her gills and oval belly, creating clear large shapes with a few smaller details.

pages.title: Lomo Axolotl with a Heart Belly Patch Coloring Page
pages.description: Lomo displays a large heart belly patch in this printable coloring page, with two short flippers beside the heart, a smiling face, and six rounded gills. The heart stays blank inside its bold outline, leaving a broad central coloring area surrounded by the simple curved body of the axolotl.

pages.title: Nico Axolotl Painting a Dinosaur Picture Coloring Page
pages.description: Nico paints a dinosaur in this printable coloring page, holding a brush toward an easel while a small palette with three paint patches rests beside his belly. The dinosaur stays inside the canvas, and the easel legs, brush, palette, six gills, and rounded flippers remain separate and clearly outlined.

pages.title: Miss Vi Axolotl Singing into a Microphone Coloring Page
pages.description: Miss Vi sings into a microphone in this printable coloring page, with a bow above her head, music notes overhead, and one flipper beside the stand. The microphone's mesh pattern adds small enclosed sections, while the round stand base and broad oval belly offer larger open areas to color.

pages.title: Jaelyn Axolotl Juggling Wrapped Candy Bars Coloring Page
pages.description: Jaelyn juggles wrapped candy bars in this printable coloring page, with three separate bars forming an arc above the head and two raised flippers below. Short motion lines show the juggling action, while the blank wrappers, six gills, smiling face, and broad belly keep the coloring sheet uncluttered.

pages.title: Irina Axolotl Balancing on a Gymnastics Beam Coloring Page
pages.description: Irina balances on a gymnastics beam in this printable coloring page, with outstretched flippers, a star on her outfit, and a rounded belly above the beam. Two angled supports hold the beam below her, and the wide outfit panels contrast with the smaller star and curved gill shapes.

pages.title: Irina Axolotl Wearing an Easter Egg Headband Coloring Page
pages.description: Irina wears an Easter egg headband in this printable coloring page, with two zigzag-patterned eggs above a bow, six side gills, and a smiling face. The headband, egg stripes, ribbon loops, and oval belly create clear sections across a simple rounded body with two short flippers.

pages.title: Jaelyn Axolotl Wearing a Heart Headband Coloring Page
pages.description: Jaelyn wears a heart headband in this printable coloring page, with two large hearts on short stems above her face and six rounded gills at the sides. Her short flippers frame the plain oval belly, leaving broad open areas beneath the smaller headband strip and decorative heart shapes.

pages.title: IndieMae Axolotl with Hearts on a Fuzzy Belly Coloring Page
pages.description: IndieMae shows a heart-patterned fuzzy belly in this printable coloring page, with six outlined hearts inside a scalloped panel, short flippers, and rounded side gills. The largest heart sits near the center, and the smaller hearts leave open gaps within the broad belly area of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Caprina Axolotl with a Spiral Unicorn Horn Coloring Page
pages.description: Caprina combines an axolotl body with a unicorn horn in this printable coloring page, with a single spiral horn, six rounded gills, and two short flippers. A smooth oval belly fills the lower body, leaving broad open areas beneath the smaller curved sections that divide the horn.

pages.title: Den Gingerbread Axolotl with Icing and a Bow Coloring Page
pages.description: Den appears as a gingerbread axolotl in this printable coloring page, with wavy icing across the head and gills, a bow tie, and three belly buttons. More icing lines cross the short flippers, while the oval belly and broad body sections leave open spaces around the smaller decorative details.
